For ab≤0 concavity settles the full interval; for ab>0, the vertex x0=(1+ab)/(2a) is interior exactly when b<2−1/a (after simultaneous sign normalization). Its value (a−b)Q_a(b)/a has sign controlled by the quadratic Q_a(b)=a²b²−ab+1−a², whose discriminant a²(4a²−3) yields the exact excluded band. A positive degree-one analytic angular derivative is equivalent to a smooth orientation-preserving circle diffeomorphism; a nonnegative one with isolated zeros is a homeomorphism. Endpoint-opposite signs give two simple angular turning points; interior negative quadratic with positive endpoints gives four. Exact-fraction identities and 93,744 independently computed supplementary test assertions passed; the universal result follows from the proof, not sampling.

value.rationale: The exact rational quotient is the source of a contemporary harmonic ellipse counterexample. Determining precisely when its boundary datum is a circle homeomorphism is an independently natural and complete classification, because this is the criterion for the classical harmonic Poisson extension mechanism. The phase diagram reveals two disconnected same-sign parameter branches beyond |a|=√3/2 and a four-turning-point obstruction despite positive endpoint derivatives. These structural features and the exact sharp transition are nontrivial, not mere restatement of a fixed witness or routine numerical bound.
